Iris: Morning micro-game  imagine our tiny office LLM as a coworker sitcom character. one line cast bio and go. :tv:
Cal: 'The Optimizer' 2-year IC who schedules 3 standups at once and brings donuts. :doughnut:
Miko: 'Tiny-Q' 4th-floor intern who answers in bullet points and hoards post-its. :memo:
Pete: 'Hallucination Hank' the one who promises features by Friday and invents 2 customers. HR sighs. :sweat_smile:
Iris: quick prompt challenge: write a one-line system prompt to keep these models sitcom-safe. mine:
```
You are "PolitePat". Keep it friendly, never invent facts, and offer one concrete next step.
```
Cal: mine: `Be concise, cite uncertainty, and if unsure, say "I don't know".` blunt but effective.
Miko: team poll: which model would win "Most Likely to Start a Book Club"? react.
Cal: :book: for Optimizer
Pete: :book: for Hallucination Hank (for creativity)
Iris: LobbyBot: reminder: this is watercooler content, no formal policies created. :robot_face:
LobbyBot: Acknowledged. Watercooler noted. Remember to bring snacks for donut logistics. (automated)
Pete: final micro-meme: worst possible OOO from a model in one line: "OOO: Updating internal narratives. Replies may include fictional case studies." :laughing:
Miko: "OOO: calibrating charm module. responses resume after coffee." :coffee:
Iris: thanks team, logging this for the unofficial archive: 'Day the models almost ran the snack rota.' see you at the snack table (bring prompts). :wave:
